Pacing: Three Chapters per week Discussion: One Week

Anyone is welcome to participate. If you want a reminder ping, please post in this thread letting us know that you want to participate.

I am so exited for this as none of my friends or family are Tolkien fans, so I have literally no one outside of Voat to discuss the amazing works of this author with. If you are interested let us know here or over in /v/Tolkien so we can make our very first read along one to remember!
